title: Outline and focus indicators
learningObjectives: Explain outline and focus indicators and use the relevant CSS properties appropriately.

understand.concept: Focus indicators show which interactive element currently receives keyboard focus. CSS :focus-visible can style focus when the browser determines that a visible indicator is appropriate. outline and outline-offset are useful because outlines generally do not affect layout.
understand.whyItMatters: A visible focus indicator is essential for keyboard users. Do not remove the browser outline unless you provide a sufficiently visible replacement for every relevant interaction state.
understand.analogy: A focus indicator is like a cursor marker showing where the next keyboard action will go.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy helps visualise the effect; CSS rendering and stacking follow browser layout and painting rules.

explain.narrative: Tab to the button. The outline shows its keyboard focus without changing the button's layout size.

examples.explanation: Tab to the button. The outline shows its keyboard focus without changing the button's layout size.
examples.expectedOutput: A browser-rendered example showing the relevant border, shadow, image-fit, or visual-effect behaviour.

practise.guidedTask: Add clear focus-visible styles to links, buttons, and form controls. Test navigation using only the keyboard.
practise.independentTask: Build a small component that uses this visual treatment without reducing readability or keyboard usability.
hints: Inspect the rendered result against different backgrounds.
Change one property at a time.
Keep focus indicators visible and content readable.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Outline and focus indicators</title></head><body>
<button class='primary'>Continue</button><style>.primary{padding:.8rem 1rem;border:1px solid #345;background:#edf4f8}.primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #c2410c;outline-offset:4px}</style>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which pseudo-class is commonly used to style keyboard focus when a visible indicator is appropriate?
questions.explanation: :focus-visible supports focus styling based on the browser's input-modality heuristics.

questions.prompt: What should you verify when adding decorative visual effects?
options: Only whether the effect looks fashionable
Whether the effect hides focus outlines
questions.explanation: Visual effects should not make content or interactive states harder to perceive.
